sections.content: Transactions group operations into all-or-nothing units: BEGIN, statements, COMMIT (save) or ROLLBACK (undo). They guarantee ACID — Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability.
Transfer money = debit one account + credit another in ONE transaction — a crash mid-way cannot lose money.
Key points: isolation levels trade consistency vs concurrency, deadlocks happen with competing locks, and keep transactions short.
Summary: Transactions — practice the example by changing values and predicting the output before running it.
